name: deepinfra
description: Pay-per-token inference for open models: chat, responses, embeddings, images, reranking and speech
long_description: Bring a DeepInfra API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key reads the account's per-model rate limits (GET /v1/me/rate_limit), which runs no model and costs nothing. A Sprite can then list models and call DeepInfra's OpenAI-compatible chat completions, text completions, Responses, embeddings and image generation endpoints under /v1/openai, including SSE streaming, and run any model by name (or your own private deployment) through the native inference endpoint, which covers reranking, text to speech and speech recognition. Every inference request is charged to your DeepInfra account. API key and scoped-JWT management, billing, usage, logs, account and team settings, deployment management, LoRA adapters, custom voices, files and batches, GPU rentals, sandboxes and hosted agents are not forwarded.

notes: Point an OpenAI SDK at this connection's gateway URL followed by `/v1/openai`; the gateway adds the key.
Set `stream: true` for SSE. For long answers stream, or keep `max_tokens` low, so the first response bytes arrive within the gateway's 120-second deadline.
`fail_fast: true` answers 429 at once instead of queueing when the model is at capacity; leave `service_tier` unset, because `flex` requests can wait up to 10 minutes and `priority` costs 50% more.

presentation.tagline: Run open models on DeepInfra from a Sprite without putting your API key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in at deepinfra.com, open Dashboard → API Keys (deepinfra.com/dash/keys) and create a key. A new key's default scopes (`inference`, `models:read`, `account:read`, `lora:read`, `voice:read`) are enough; a scoped key needs at least `inference` and `account:read`.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key reads `GET /v1/me/rate_limit`, which runs no model and costs nothing; listing models is free too. Every other forwarded request runs a model and is charged to your DeepInfra account at that model's price on deepinfra.com/pricing: language, embedding and reranking models mostly per token, speech recognition per minute of audio, and other image and speech models per image or by inference time, as each model's page says. DeepInfra needs a card or prepaid balance before it serves requests. `service_tier: "priority"` adds 50% and `"flex"` takes 20% off. Requests a model rejects with `fail_fast` are not billed.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `GET /v1/openai/models`, `POST /v1/openai/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/openai/completions`, `POST /v1/openai/responses`, `POST /v1/openai/embeddings`, `POST /v1/openai/images/generations`, `POST /v1/inference/:owner/:model` and `GET /v1/me/rate_limit` are forwarded. The native inference route runs any `owner/model` the key may use, and `/v1/inference/deploy/DEPLOY_ID` for your own private deployments. API keys, scoped JWTs, billing, usage, logs, account and team settings, managing private deployments, LoRA adapters, custom voices, files, batches, GPU rentals, sandboxes and hosted agents are not.

usage_notes: OpenAI-compatible routes live under `/v1/openai`, so an OpenAI SDK pointed at this connection's gateway URL plus `/v1/openai` works unchanged for models, chat, completions, Responses, embeddings and images.

The gateway waits 120 seconds for response headers and DeepInfra has no per-request timeout parameter, so stream long generations (`stream: true`), keep `max_tokens` bounded and avoid `service_tier: "flex"`, which can queue for up to 10 minutes.

Errors on the OpenAI-compatible routes are `{"error": {"message", "type", "code"}}`; other routes answer `{"detail": ...}`. A request outside the key's scopes is a 403 naming the missing scope. Public models allow 200 concurrent requests per model by default and answer 429 above that or when a model is busy.
